title: The Communion and Communicant

In the text, Hoare articulates the sacrament's purpose and outlines the importance of partaking in it worthily. Through scripture references and theological reflections, Hoare aims to promote a deeper appreciation of the communion, encouraging believers to examine their hearts and approach the sacrament with faith, recognizing it as an opportunity for spiritual growth, forgiveness, and connection with Christ.
